prompt:
Production animation sheet of Vera,27,young woman with silver-gray short tousled bob, teacher, graphite-smudged fingers, pencil behind ear. Aubergine civilian long coat with teal lining over cream ordinary shirt and worn gray trousers, scuffed boots, notebook and reused school satchel. Holds a homemade electromagnetic pulse device built from an old antenna, exposed cables and a salvaged battery, with small cyan arcs; NO magic staff, NO robes, NO plate armor. Curious determined civilian, not military.. TWELVE distinct coherent full-body drawings, FOUR columns THREE rows: raise the held tool/shield to brace, absorb impact, return to guard. Same scale/camera in every cell, generous transparent gutters, planted foot baseline identical, no cropping, no labels, no terrain.
NEW FINAL ART DIRECTION: original printed American action COMIC BOOK, this is a full REDRAW of the illustration. Strong expressive black ink outlines, angular purposeful shapes, two-tone cel shadows, vivid controlled hero accents on a dark violet/steel/petrol palette, visible Ben-Day halftone clusters and occasional dry ink. A clear THIN WHITE PAPER CUTOUT border around every person, machine, standalone object and icon silhouette. Comics cut-paper aesthetic, NOT 3D, NOT realistic painting, NOT pixel art, NOT generic airbrushed fantasy. Civilian survivors versus autonomous killing machines; retain their identities, jobs, workwear and improvised tools. No superhero costumes. The illustration must visibly feel like hand-inked printed comic art.
